about: Synthetic records for the wire format in docs/format/02-records-wire-format.md, produced with Banking4. Do not edit.

notation.framing: bare: the file is one record body (a chunk sequence) without a size prefix. collection: the file is a sequence of size-prefixed records as in a collection file.
notation.ops: The primitives of one record in wire order. write is the value that was written, read is the expected value of reading the same bytes, end is the cursor after that read, counted from the start of the record body. next_chunk closes the chunk and starts another.
notation.u16: write is the 32-bit value the 16 stored bits were taken from.
notation.decimal: text is the value with its scale; negative, magnitude and scale are the exact parts.
notation.string: A JSON string, null, or {repeat, times, suffix} for long values. Characters outside ASCII are escaped; an unpaired surrogate appears as a lone \uD800..\uDFFF escape.
notation.blob: Hex, null, or {pattern: index_mod_251, length} for long values (byte i is i mod 251).
notation.date_raw: {year, month, day} as stored, or null for the null date.
notation.timestamp: date_clamped, date_strict and ticks: {ticks, iso, marked_as} or null for the zero timestamp. marked_as is the UTC/local marker of the in-memory value, which is not stored.
notation.hex: The bytes of the file; null for files above 2048 bytes, which are identified by size and sha256 only.
